descriptions: 补丁前 secure_display_ctxs 的实际分配规模与后续循环索引上界不一致：数组按 AMDGPU_MAX_CRTCS 分配，但循环按 adev->dm.dc->caps.max_links 遍历并消费 secure_display_ctxs[i]。当 max_links 大于已分配元素数时，flush_work、字段比较、INIT_WORK、crtc 赋值等对 secure_display_ctxs[i] 的访问会越界。补丁后 kcalloc 和所有相关 for 循环都改为 adev->mode_info.num_crtc，使分配数量和索引上界一致。

semantic_payload.label: Functions implicated by removed or fixed code

suggestions: 首稿优先命中最小 patch-local 锚点：for (i = 0; i < adev->dm.dc->caps.max_links; i++) 循环体内访问 secure_display_ctxs[i] 或 adev->dm.secure_display_ctxs[i]
另一个强锚点是 kcalloc(AMDGPU_MAX_CRTCS, sizeof(struct secure_display_context), ...) 后同函数内用 max_links 初始化 secure_display_ctxs[i]
不要把新增的 num_crtc 边界作为首稿硬过滤；它更适合作为已修复代码的 barrier，用于排除 patched 版本
辅助收敛条件可以要求索引变量来自同一 for 循环、数组名为 secure_display_ctxs、循环上界为 adev->dm.dc->caps.max_links、或分配数量为 AMDGPU_MAX_CRTCS
若只追求首批命中，局部 AST/CFG 匹配循环上界和数组索引已足够；若要证明真实越界风险，再追踪 secure_display_ctxs 的 kcalloc 元素数量与跨函数字段保存关系

patch_semantic_context.knighter_original_generation_plan_excerp:
Your plan here

1. Determine that no extra program state maps are needed because the checker only needs to inspect the source text of branch conditions within loop constructs.

2. Use the callback function checkBranchCondition to hook branch conditions:
   • In checkBranchCondition, obtain the source text of the condition using the provided utility function (ExprHasName) or Lexer utilities.
   • Inspect the condition’s text for the specific string "dc->caps.max_links". This indicates that the loop or if condition is using the incorrect upper bound.
   • Optionally, traverse upward (using findSpecificTypeInParents) to verify that this condition is part of a ForStmt or similar loop construct.

3. Generate a bug report if the condition contains "dc->caps.max_links":
   • Create a bug report using std::make_unique<BasicBugReport> (or PathSensitiveBugReport) with a short message like "Incorrect upper bound: use mode_info.num_crtc instead of dc->caps.max_links".
   • Emit the report via the CheckerContext.

4. No pointer alias or taint tracking is needed, so you do not require additional checkBind or program state modifications.

By following these steps in checkBranchCondition, you can effectively detect the bug pattern where the incorrect upper bound is used in iteration, and then issue a concise and clear bug report.

patch_semantic_context.knighter_pattern_excerpt:
## Bug Pattern

Using an incorrect upper bound for iteration and memory allocation. Specifically, the code incorrectly uses adev->dm.dc->caps.max_links (which may be larger than available CRTCs) to determine the iteration count and size of the secure_display_ctxs array, instead of using adev->mode_info.num_crtc. This mismatch in bounds can lead to buffer overflows by accessing unallocated memory.
